material_findings.finding: Funding rate, open interest and other values from unauthenticated public endpoints remain OKX Market Data and are not free of use restrictions merely because no API key is required.
The available license is limited, revocable and restricted to the user's own internal, personal, non-commercial trading and account-management purposes.
Raw or reconstructable Market Data must not be published, redistributed, resold, exposed to third parties or used in a competing data or commercial analytics product without prior written consent.
Market Data must not be used to train, fine-tune or evaluate an AI system intended for commercialization or third-party availability.

material_findings.basis: Agreement section 9.4 automated scraping and circumvention restrictions
material_findings.finding: Automated access must remain reasonably necessary for personal trading use, respect published limits and avoid high-frequency, large-scale, circumvention or unreasonable platform load.

material_findings.basis: Agreement sections 3.1, 9.7 and 15 plus API V5 documentation
material_findings.finding: Endpoint schemas, access rights and agreement terms can change or be revoked, so source activation requires a fresh schema receipt and recurring terms-version review.

permitted_research_envelope.purpose: Private evidence generation for the user's own non-commercial trading research
permitted_research_envelope.request_scope: The four credential-free request identities frozen by the V3 source contract
permitted_research_envelope.initial_probe: One schema-only probe that records keys and value types but no market values
permitted_research_envelope.prospective_capture: Only after separate source activation review; bounded frequency and rows; no endpoint expansion
permitted_research_envelope.storage: Access-controlled private research state only; no raw values in publishable reports, prompts or source-controlled examples
permitted_research_envelope.outputs: Aggregate internal research diagnostics that do not expose or reconstruct OKX Market Data
permitted_research_envelope.trading_scope: Research only; no order, account, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE activation

prohibited_or_unproven_uses: Commercial strategy, signal, analytics, data-feed or marketplace distribution
Third-party access to raw or reconstructable OKX Market Data
Commercialized or third-party AI training, fine-tuning or evaluation
High-frequency or large-scale extraction without a separate data license
Rate-limit, regional-domain, account-eligibility or technical-control circumvention
Any claim that this review is legal advice or written OKX consent
activation_conditions: The operator confirms the use remains personal, internal and non-commercial for the user's own trading research.
A fresh approved isolated schema-only receipt passes the frozen V3 offline validator.
No raw or reconstructable Market Data is sent to third parties or placed in publishable artifacts.
The capture remains within the four frozen public requests and bounded rate and row limits.
The applicable regional domain, user eligibility and current agreement version are checked before activation.
Any agreement or endpoint change forces fail-closed re-review before further capture.
